&1558 So I got out...I managed to find somewhere to lie low...
target: &1558 所以，我逃出来了……找了个地方躲起来……

source: &1559 But I know what Central's capable of...you can only hide from it for so long...
target: &1559 可我知道中枢有什么本事……躲它，也只能躲那么久……

source: &1560 Lao had better find that message before an aerostat comes this way.
target: &1560 劳最好赶在浮空艇过来之前，找到那条消息。

&128 -pfffzzzt -ou hear me?
&1562 Hello? Who's there?
&1563 Someone managed to get this through the window - they must have one Hell of a pitching arm...
target: &1563 有人居然把这东西从窗外扔进来，胳膊劲儿可真够大的……

source: Picked up: Thermal Bottle
&1564 What the Hell is this...?
&1565 A battered door. It's got the former occupant's name stenciled on it.
target: &1565 一扇破旧的门。上面用模板喷着上一位使用者的名字。

source: &1566 It's empty. Nothing's loaded into the fire suppressant system.
target: &1566 空的。灭火系统里没装任何东西。

source: &1567 There's a canister of water-soluble fire suppressant loaded into the system.
target: &1567 系统里装着一罐水溶性灭火剂。

source: &1568 Looks like the red paint canister was compatible.
target: &1568 看来，红色油漆罐也能装进去。

source: &1569 The gauge says that the tank's exhausted.
target: &1569 压力表显示，罐子已经空了。

source: &1570 It's the fire-safety system. Probably hasn't been used in years.
target: &1570 消防系统。大概好多年没用过了。

source: &1571 Huh...it fits...
&1572 The system only takes fluid tanks.
&1573 It's not going to be compatible with it.
&1574 I guess some things, you just have to store physically.
target: &1574 有些东西，还是得存成实体。

source: &1575 The rest of it's decade-old paperwork.
target: &1575 剩下的都是十年前的纸质文件。

source: &1576 Looks like this guy had a place to keep his vices at work.
target: &1576 看来，这家伙在上班的地方还藏着些不良嗜好。

source: Picked up: Cigarette Lighter
&1577 I wonder if it even still works.
&1578 I can't reach it from down here.
&1579 Huh...must be empty.
&1581 Lousy kids can't even do their own graffiti anymore without a bot's help.
target: &1581 现在的小鬼真没用，连涂鸦都得靠机器人帮忙。

source: &1582 Nothing else in here looks like it'd work anymore.
target: &1582 这里其他的东西，看着都没法用了。

source: &1583 Must've been a decorator.
Picked up: Paint cartridge
&1584 An old office terminal. I'm kinda suprised nobody's stolen it yet.
target: &1584 一台旧办公终端。居然还没人偷走，有点意外。

source: &517 A painting of a glowing pyramid, hanging over a city. Despite the other 'decoration' that the walls of this office has acquired, this picture remains unvandalized.
target: &517 画中，一座发光的金字塔悬在城市上空。虽然这间办公室的墙上多了不少其他“装饰”，这幅画却没有遭到破坏。

source: &524 You can't think of anywhere that the painting would go well, even if it hadn't suffered from a decade of neglect.
target: &524 就算不是十年无人打理的模样，你也想不出这幅画适合放在哪里。

source: This part of town is full of disused factories, abandoned after an environmental catastrophe a decade earlier. While CEL technically has a mandate to keep it safe, the expense of doing so means that it rarely gets patrolled.
target: 这片城区到处都是废弃工厂，十年前一场环境灾难之后便无人使用。理论上，CEL有责任保障这里的安全，可费用太高，所以很少有人来巡逻。
